record.paper_title: Hénon maps: a list of open problems
record.context_brief: connectedness locus of the complex Hénon family
record.original_question: For the connectedness locus M={(c,b)∈C^2 : J_{c,b} is connected} of the complex Hénon family f_{c,b}(x,y)=(x^2+c-by,x), is M disconnected?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
For parameters $(c,b)\in\mathbb{C}^2$ with $b\neq 0$, consider the complex Hénon map
$$f_{c,b}:\mathbb{C}^2\to\mathbb{C}^2,\qquad f_{c,b}(x,y)=(x^2+c-by,\;x).$$
Let $K_{c,b}^+=\{p\in\mathbb{C}^2:\{f_{c,b}^n(p)\}_{n\ge 0}\text{ is bounded}\}$ and $K_{c,b}^-=\{p\in\mathbb{C}^2:\{f_{c,b}^{-n}(p)\}_{n\ge 0}\text{ is bounded}\}$, and set $K_{c,b}=K_{c,b}^+\cap K_{c,b}^-$. The Julia set is $J_{c,b}=\partial K_{c,b}^+\cap\partial K_{c,b}^-$. Define the connectedness locus
$$\mathcal{M}=\{(c,b)\in\mathbb{C}^*\times\mathbb{C}:\,J_{c,b}\text{ is connected}\}\subset\mathbb{C}^2.$$
Prove or disprove: $\mathcal{M}$ is disconnected as a subset of $\mathbb{C}^2$.
artifact.status_search_result: The question of whether the connectedness locus $\mathcal{M}$ of the complex Hénon family is disconnected is stated as a conjecture in recent problem lists on Hénon dynamics. Partial evidence is known: the real slice $\mathcal{M}\cap\mathbb{R}^2$ has been shown to be disconnected, but the full complex statement appears to remain open as of recent surveys and workshop reports (e.g., BIRS 2023 workshop on Hénon dynamics).

status_evidence.title: Dynamics of Hénon maps: real, complex and beyond (BIRS report)
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses open problems on the complex Hénon family including connectedness properties of the parameter locus.
status_evidence.claim: The disconnectedness of the complex Hénon connectedness locus is listed among current open problems.

status_evidence.title: On Parameter Loci of the Hénon Family
status_evidence.snippet: Establishes results on the hyperbolic horseshoe locus of the real Hénon family, showing connectedness/disconnectedness phenomena for real parameter loci.
status_evidence.claim: Provides partial results in the real-parameter slice, but does not settle the complex case.
